Predicates:
Created(x, y) ::: x created y.
Game(x) ::: x is a game.
OnTop10(x) ::: x is on the Top 10 list.
MadeBy(x, y) ::: x is made by y.
JapaneseCompany(x) ::: x is a Japanese game company.
SoldMoreThanOneMillionCopies(x) ::: x sold more than one million copies.
Sold(x) ::: x sold copies.
Conclusion:
Created(legendOfZelda, game) ::: The Legend of Zelda was created.
MadeBy(legendOfZelda, japaneseCompany) ::: The Legend of Zelda was made by a Japanese game company.
SoldMoreThanOneMillionCopies(legendOfZelda) ::: The Legend of Zelda sold more than one million copies.
OnTop10(legendOfZelda) ::: The Legend of Zelda is on the Top 10 list.
